Delegate cultural assessment to corporate communications without compliance involvement.
Test speak-up and leadership behaviors, address local barriers, and track whether employee experience improves.
Focus exclusively on increasing the annual policy attestation rate.
explanation: The best choice is to test speak-up and leadership behaviors, address local barriers, and track whether employee experience improves. This approach focuses on ethical culture rather than relying on an untested shortcut. The other options either substitute assertions for evidence, postpone assessment, or weaken accountability. Editorial basis: CEP 2025-04, How ethics and compliance officers can improve organizational culture, p. 63; verify the precise article passage before using this in a scored mock exam.
